messages:
melissa_cs: Client 'Riverbend Health' SI delivery stalled. Customer reports failing post-install connectivity checks to our telemetry endpoint (telemetry.redwood-inference.com). SI says their firewall blocks outbound telemetry to unknown cloud domains. Any quick workarounds?

omar_se: Telemetry uses TLS to telemetry.redwood-inference.com:443 and mTLS client cert for authentication. If firewalls block unknown FQDNs, they can allow the specific IP range: 34.215.0.0/16 and 54.200.0.0/16 (our telemetry egress).

vendor_eng: Riverbend's security policy mandates egress only to fixed IPs and disallows mTLS unless certs are validated by their PKI. We might need to support client-provided certs for telemetry to satisfy their controls.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: Private deployments can opt into syslog-forwarding or S3 push as alternate telemetry collection. Docs: https://redwood.cloud/private/telemetry-options

tess_ops: Short-term we can enable S3 push of telemetry artifacts to a pre-signed bucket owned by the SI. That bypasses the need for outbound connections, but reduces live monitoring.

rachel_pm: Product note: This is a recurring ask from multi-regional healthcare partners. We should consider an "offline telemetry" pattern for private installs. Add to roadmap?

melissa_cs: Client wants to keep go-live this week. Vendor can accept S3 push temporarily. Tess, can you provision?

tess_ops: Provisioning pre-signed S3 delivery now. Will set lifecycle to 30 days and enable server-side encryption with partner KMS. URL will be DM'd to SI.

omar_se: We also need a secure bootstrap step so the instance can fetch SAS token from our control plane during install. If network blocks outbound, partner must place token in install bundle. Document that as install preflight.

vendor_eng: Noted. Also looping in Vendor IT to review KMS key access for the S3 bucket.

marketplace-bot: Telemetry tool change request ticket auto-created: #TCK-8823

rachel_pm: I'll coordinate product follow-up and slot "offline telemetry" in next planning. For now let's proceed with S3 push and capture post-install logs to validate.

melissa_cs: Thanks all. I'll update Riverbend and confirm the go-live window. If anything breaks, escalate.
